title: Memory in Claude Cowork and Editable Topics
description: Memory in Claude Cowork now works across chat and Cowork in the cloud. Individual entries can be listed under Topics in Settings with editable/deletable entries. Sensitive topics setting introduced to control what stays in memory.

community_feedback.quote: Users discussing memory issues and migration solutions with Claude-Mem as a solution for persistent memory
Comprehensive memory management uses background agent to review coding session transcripts and identify patterns

title: Browser Extensions and Cloud Sign-in
description: Expanded browser extension support to Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, and Vivaldi. Introduced Site tools (WebMCP) allowing ChatGPT Work and Codex to use tools provided by websites in desktop app's built-in browser. Cloud browser sign-in for eligible plans.

title: Scheduled Tasks from Events
description: ChatGPT scheduled tasks can now run when events occur in Gmail, Slack, or GitHub. Filter Gmail messages, watch Slack channels, or respond to pull request activity.

title: GitHub Copilot App Customize Tab Generally Available
description: The Customize tab in the GitHub Copilot app is now generally available for all users.

title: Apple Messages Plugin and Site Co-editing
description: Apple Messages plugin can read and search Messages chats on macOS. Site co-editing allows owners to invite workspace members as editors. Editable Site URLs let you change addresses without redeployment.

title: GitLab Support (Beta)
description: Connect GitLab projects to Codex cloud, create environments, and request merge request reviews.

community_feedback.quote: Integration discussed for automated code quality and security fixes in GitLab pipelines

title: Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness Improvements
description: Agents can automatically monitor PRs, watch Slack threads, or run scheduled tasks. Custom Modes convert skills into persistent modes. Subagents can run on isolated machines. New /goal command for long-lived objectives.

title: Major UI Redesigns and Session Management
description: Redesigned session page header with compact design, tags and hierarchy. Sessions sidebar with customizable nav tabs, grouping, richer filtering. Refreshed chat visual design. Hideable sidebar with peek on hover.

title: Code Scanning & Security Enhancements
description: Finding resolution notes now shown in UI. Code scan security profile can be changed from UI. Scan effort selection (normal/deep). New v3 scan API endpoints for incremental scans.

title: New GitHub Copilot Experience in Slack
description: Updated Copilot integration with Slack bringing agentic coding help into team conversations.

community_feedback.quote: Do we really need another place to talk to an AI?
Features include code channels, diff inspection, output previews for team collaboration

title: Shared Agentic Work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
description: New Teams integration allows sharing agentic coding work within Microsoft Teams.

community_feedback.quote: Discussion about Copilot integrating with chat-based delegation capabilities

title: Performance and UX Improvements
description: Image lightboxes with filename captions, image counter, and clickable prev/next arrows. PR diff files virtualized for faster session switching. Preview tab renamed to Browser. Faster PR tab loading.

title: Slack Integration Improvements
description: Muting a Devin session in Slack now disconnects it from the Slack thread. Default org picker in Slack DMs.

title: Origin Code Hosting
description: Cursor now hosts code with repos, pull requests, code browsing, and GitHub sync. GitHub repos can sync alongside Cursor-hosted repos with real-time updates and bidirectional PR syncing. App extensions with Vercel, Depot, and Buildkite integrations available.

title: Devin Coach and High Contrast Mode
description: Devin Coach surfaces suggestions directly in the session input box as you write. High contrast mode with system option. Smarter re-review behavior skips re-reviewing PRs when diff is unchanged.

title: Grok 4.6 Model Available
description: Grok 4.6 model is now available in GitHub Copilot.

title: Side Chats and Syntax Highlighting
description: Side chats allow starting conversations anchored to any point in a session. Syntax-highlighted code blocks in chat. Slack thread follow-ups with automatic routing.

title: Cloud Agents Start 3x Faster with Builds
description: New builds feature creates ready-to-use environment copies prepared in background. Agents boot into prepared environments instead of setting up from scratch. 10x faster environment boot times with 3x faster time to first token.

title: Gemini 3.7 Flash Model Available
description: Gemini 3.7 Flash model is now available in GitHub Copilot.

title: Agent Plugins 1.0 Released
description: Agent Plugins 1.0 released for VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app.

title: Queueing Support and Governance Features
description: Queueing support with maximum concurrent runs and queue depth per automation. Security profiles now generally available. Automations API promoted to production v3 spec. Personal access tokens generally available.

title: Copilot Memory and Ollama in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
description: New memory features and Ollama integration added to GitHub Copilot for JetBrains.

title: Linux Preview and Import from Claude Code and Cursor
description: ChatGPT desktop app for Linux available in preview. Added ability to import setup from Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Cursor using /import command.

title: Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red Tiers
description: New access tiers for approved defenders: Blue for general-purpose security work, Red for authorized vulnerability reproduction and penetration testing.

title: v0.54.0 Release - PR Automation & Antigravity Agent
description: Integrated the Antigravity agent runner with dual-locking Firestore concurrency controls to secure the PR generator. Enhanced caretaker triaging to post comments prior to auto-closing issues. Security improvements prevented cleartext credential leakage.

title: Skill and Plugin Security Scanning (Beta)
description: Enterprise plans can now scan third-party skills and plugins for malicious content when someone uploads or edits them.
